svg.title: Powered Land Qualification, From Megawatts Back to Dirt
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-powered-land-qualification-flow; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: Powered Land Qualification, From Megawatts Back to Dirt; subtitle: Start from available power, then work backward to acreage, line, redundancy and site control; caption: Power is the site and acreage follows. Powered land trades at about 4x to 5x unpowered land in current data center deals (datacenterHawk).; assumptions note: Step order follows the practitioner operator gates. Acreage, study-cost, run-out and upfront-security figures are attributed practitioner claims from Franklin Andrew Cruz, Advanta IRA (Mike Embry), datacenterHawk and Systems Leverage, not independent estimates.; note: Attributed to Franklin Andrew Cruz (YrpzmGX0-YM), Advanta IRA (3rM3iGzRRUA), datacenterHawk (dTHn2ejpXvM) and Systems Leverage (nx4eX4emlwE).; stages: step: 01; label: Call the utility for 100MW-plus; value: Step 1; detail: Ask directly whether the utility can support 100MW or more; the call routes to the department handling 50MW-plus loads, the desk that matters (Franklin Andrew Cruz).; step: 02; label: Screen acreage at 1MW per acre; value: Step 2; detail: Hold a 100-acre floor; below it, AI data center buyers will not look at the site (Franklin Andrew Cruz).; step: 03; label: Pin the plan to a named line; value: Step 3; detail: Tie the concept plan to a specific line such as a 230 and keep a multifamily or Kroger commercial Plan B ready before paying the study fee; Embry cites $60k to $140k spent to get the power company answer, and power run-outs at $20M per mile (Advanta IRA).; step: 04; label: Name the redundancy source; value: Step 4; detail: Identify a gas or coal plant for redundancy before advancing; Embry's Decatur, Alabama site in TVA territory died for lack of one (Advanta IRA).; step: 05; label: Lock the dirt with an option contract; value: Step 5; detail: Control land through options, from 2-3 year solar options to Stargate's $1 option; one deal required $22M posted upfront to secure power after zoning (Advanta IRA, Systems Leverage).
